Here are the UG and MSc modules I am connected to at Warwick. 

## UG

At an undergraduate level, I am module leader and (co-)lecturer for:

- Econometrics 2: Microeconometrics ([EC338](https://warwick.ac.uk/fac/soc/economics/current/modules/ec338/))
- Research Methods in Economics ([EC346](https://warwick.ac.uk/fac/soc/economics/current/modules/ec346/))

I am also a seminar tutor (or supervisor) for:

- Econometrics 1 ([EC226](https://warwick.ac.uk/fac/soc/economics/current/modules/ec226/))
- Econometrics 2: Microeconometrics ([EC338](https://warwick.ac.uk/fac/soc/economics/current/modules/ec338/))
- Data Science for Economists ([EC349](https://warwick.ac.uk/fac/soc/economics/current/modules/ec349/))
- Research in Applied Economics ([EC331](https://warwick.ac.uk/fac/soc/economics/current/modules/ec331/))
- Research Methods in Economics ([EC346](https://warwick.ac.uk/fac/soc/economics/current/modules/ec346/))
